{{Quote|That was when I went with a relief group to Shadda-Bi-Boran. Their sun was imploding and the planet was dying. I was helping to relocate the children.|Padmé Amidala, explaining a holograph of her younger self to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="AOTC novel" />}}
The '''Shadda-Bi-Boran exodus''' was the mass evacuation of the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran (species)|Shadda-Bi-Boran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Death/Legends|dying]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]]. The [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] attempted to evacuate the species to a selection of other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that had the potential to support the needs of the Shadda-Bi-Borans. However, all of them ultimately perished.
